title: Signal: Unescaped HTML sink Phoenix.HTML.raw (elixir) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the Phoenix.HTML.raw call in elixir code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any Phoenix.HTML.raw call matches, including trusted constant markup. Whether the value is attacker-controlled needs human review.
fpNotes: Rendering trusted constant templates is the common false positive.
